Assume there exists an open $U \subset X$ with complement $Z = X \setminus U$ such that \begin{enumerate} \item $U \to X$ is affine, \item $j^{-1}(U) \to U$ is affine, and \item $j(Y) \cap Z$ is closed. \end{enumerate} Then $j$ is affine. \item $j(Y) \cap Z$ is closed.
\end{enumerate}
